programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E20 — Pedido de Casamento AtribuladoMr. Bean está à espera da Irma no parque para um piquenique, quando vê um homem nervoso a ensaiar um pedido de casamento. Mr. Bean tenta mostrar como fazer o pedido, mas faz com o que anel de noivado saia disparado pelo ar. Aterra no cesto de uma bicicleta, voa até um carrinho de bebé.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E21 — Uma Planta ValiosaMr. Bean foi instruído pelo senhor Paliwal para regar a sua preciosa planta uma vez por dia, enquanto está de férias. Tudo corre bem e Mr. Bean está a divertir-se com as engenhocas do vizinho. Contudo, um dia, esquece-se da sua tarefa e tem de entrar à noite em casa do vizinho.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E22 — Bean e o Caixote do LixoMr. Bean fica tão admirado, quando o homem do lixo se recusa a despejar o caixote, porque está cheio e a tampa não fecha. Quando consegue fechá-la, o camião já desapareceu. Então, ele mete o caixote em frente a outras casas, à espera que homem do lixo não repare e o leve.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E23 — Férias em CasaMr. Bean leva Irma até ao aeroporto, ela e a Lottie vão passar férias ao sol sem ele. Para animar o Teddy, Mr. Bean tem uma grande ideia, passar férias sem sair de casa. Então, recria todas as coisas que viu no catálogo da Irma.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E24 — A Feira PopularNa feira popular, Mr. Bean ganha um balão para o Teddy e ata-o a ele, enquanto tenta apanhar um pato. Mas está tão concentrado, que nem vê o seu companheiro a afastar-se pelo ar. Mr. Bean persegue o Teddy, enquanto ele desliza ou fica preso em várias atrações da feira.[AD].

programme.title: Mush-Mush e os Mushimelos
programme.desc: S2 E10 — Senhor Calças de MusgoChep arranja umas calças de musgo que o tornam mais forte e um pouco vaidoso.

programme.title: Mush-Mush e os Mushimelos
programme.desc: S2 E11 — Cobras e FormigasMush-Mush e Truff unem-se para vencer o seu medo de cobras e formigas.

programme.title: Mush-Mush e os Mushimelos
programme.desc: S2 E12 — Pequenos ProblemasMushpot e Starmush cuidam dos Bebémelos, mas é mais difícil do que parece.

programme.title: Mush-Mush e os Mushimelos
programme.desc: S2 E13 — Retrato de um MushimeloQuando Cantarela se oferece para pintar o retrato de Sushi-Mushi, o entusiasmo dele depressa se torna preocupação.

programme.title: Mush-Mush e os Mushimelos
programme.desc: S2 E14 — Mushpie Pelos AresPara mostrar aos Minimelos que eles devem arriscar e seguir os seus sonhos, Mushpie decide fazer Folha-pente.

programme.title: Mush-Mush e os Mushimelos
programme.desc: S2 E15 — Pastéis do PuffPuff quer mostrar a sua comida a vapor, mas o Sushi-Mushi receia a concorrência.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Lemingues AranhaOs Lemingues apanharam uma pequena aranha. Os seus fios pegajosos e elásticos são absolutamente perfeitos para fazer saltos bungee. Grizzy que não tem intenções de ser apanhado na teia decide esmagar o inseto.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S1 E16 — Urso AleatórioGrizzy e os Lemingues lutam por tampas de frascos de pasta de chocolate, que usam como fichas numa competição para ganhar coisas boas. É que mesmo ao lado do supermercado há duas máquinas estilo jackpot com ranhuras do tamanho das tampas.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S1 E17 — Interferência LemingueGrizzy preparou para si um jantar TV para comer à frente da sua série favorita. Mas o seu momento de prazer é abruptamente interrompido por estática inexplicada. Grizzy descobre rapidamente que a verdadeira interferência são os Lemingues que estão a usar a antena da TV como prancha de saltos para...

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S1 E18 — Ataque de Urso de Alta TensãoOs Lemingues estão a dar uma rave. Quando Grizzy atira ao rio o seu enorme rádio portátil provoca uma falha de luz geral. A menos que consiga encontrar uma fonte alternativa de energia e antes que os Lemingues o façam bem pode dizer adeus à sua noite de TV!

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S1 E19 — Aromas de UrsoQuando se apercebe de que a sua bem-amada ursa adora o cheiro de flores Grizzy decide oferecer-lhe os gerânios que decoram os parapeitos das janelas da cabana do guarda. Conseguirá levar-lhos sem que os Lemingues que estão à espreita junto ao monte de estrume de caribu arruínem o efeito que deseja?

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S1 E20 — Sorte de UrsoNão é decididamente o dia de Grizzy: tendo feito figura de parvo à frente da ursa por quem está apaixonado é expulso da cabana de troncos pelos Lemingues que estão em grande forma. Grizzy vai parar a um campo de trevo onde repara que um deles - que tem quatro folhas - parece trazer-lhe boa sorte.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S1 E21 — Urso MagnéticoGrizzy até duvida do que vê quando vê objetos a moverem-se sozinhos. Quando se apercebe de que são os Lemingues que andam a brincar com um íman particularmente potente tem um rasgo e génio. Irá conceber um truque de telecinesia para impressionar a sua bem-amada ursa.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E50 — Doente a FingirMr. Bean prepara-se para a ver a maratona do seu programa preferido na TV, quando a Irma lhe liga para o lembrar de que vão jantar com a mãe. Ele finge estar doente, mas corre mal, quando a Irma vem tomar conta dele. Depressa se aproveita da Irma que está a cuidar dele.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E51 — Janela para a VitóriaO Sr. Paliwal está a organizar os vizinhos para limparem a rua e vencerem "A Rua Mais Bonita da Grã-Bretanha". Mas quando a limpeza de vidros cancela, Mr. Bean vê uma oportunidade de ganhar dinheiro e oferece-se para ajudar.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E52 — Uma Surpresa para a IrmaQuando Mr. Bean se esquece do aniversário da Irma, pede a Divya que construa uma escultura de gelo parecida com ela. Fica fantástica, mas o sol aparece e a escultura começa a derreter. Mr. Bean decide levá-la para casa para a proteger do sol, mas nem isso resulta.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E1 — Um Dia Na CamaMr. Bean e Teddy não têm planos e decidem passar o dia na cama. Mr. Bean está determinado a não tocar no chão e empurra a cama pela casa com uma vassoura. Tem de encontrar uma forma engenhosa de preparar o chá e a torrada para o pequeno-almoço e escovar os dentes.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E2 — Competição de KartMr. Bean vê o novo kart que o Sr. Paliwal comprou para a filha Divya e decide construir um com o Billy, usando materiais do quintal da Sra. Wicket. Na pista de corridas do parque, Mr. Bean e Paliwal não ficam impressionados com as capacidades de condução de Billy e Divya.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E3 — Bólingue DesastrosoMr. Bean e Teddy vão jogar uma partida de bólingue grátis, mas Mr. Bean acha mais difícil do que esperava. Ao ver uma criança com uma bola mais pequena, ele pega nela, ao pensar que é mais fácil de usar. Mas fica com os dedos presos e provoca o caos ao tentar libertar-se.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E4 — Venda de AmostrasBean está com Irma na sua banca do tricô no mercado e mesmo ao lado estão a vender chaleiras em forma de carro. Mr. Bean fica encantado com uma chaleira em forma de mini verde, mas não tem dinheiro para a comprar.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E5 — De CastigoMr. Bean está a assistir ao Clint Queixo-de-Aço, o seu programa de televisão preferido, com o Billy, mas a Senhora Wicket obriga o neto a ir para casa terminar as tarefas. Inspirado pelo lema de Clint, "Ninguém é deixado para trás.

programme.title: Mush-Mush e os Mushimelos
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Prato MalditoOs Jovimelos convencem o Sushi-Mushi de que o Mushpot adora picles de compodre.

programme.title: Mush-Mush e os Mushimelos
programme.desc: S2 E2 — Sê Forte, Chep!Chep não consegue usar uma catapulta até descobrir que o segredo é a técnica.

programme.title: Mush-Mush e os Mushimelos
programme.desc: S2 E3 — Pergunta ao Starmush!Mush-Mush quer o Starmush a viver na aldeia para responder às suas perguntas.

programme.title: Mush-Mush e os Mushimelos
programme.desc: S2 E4 — A Liana BambaLilit nunca aprendeu a andar na liana bamba, mas vai ter uma nova oportunidade.

programme.title: Mush-Mush e os Mushimelos
programme.desc: S2 E5 — À Procura da LuzLilit organiza um noite para ver pirilampos, mas Chep e Mush Mush não a ouvem.

programme.title: Tom e Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Luta de ComidaA hora do lanche transforma-se em hora da caça quando Tom apanha Jerry a tirar comida do frigorífico!

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S4 E16 — Canal por CaboGrizzy e os Lemmings não estão de acordo em relação a que programa ver na televisão. Grizzy confisca o comando da televisão. Ele acha que venceu a batalha, mas os Lemmings encontram outro na estação de investigação.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S4 E17 — Taça GeladaOs Lemmings divertem-se numa corrida a descer a rampa de gelo, competindo contra um Urso-ranger de peluche, conseguindo ganhar sempre. Grizzy não suporta ver o seu avatar humilhado e decide entrar na competição para o ajudar.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S4 E18 — Granizado de ChocolateGrizzy vê os Lemmings a raspar gelo do campo de gelo para fazer granita, mas o resultado é algo sem sabor. Ele decide fazer granita num frasco de Yummy vazio, para que o chocolate que sobra nos lados do frasco dê sabor à sobremesa. Fica deliciosa!

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S4 E19 — Refeição RápidaGrizzy e os Lemmings estão esfomeados, pois as suas reservas estão esgotadas e não tiveram sucesso na pesca. Felizmente, uma carrinha entrega uma caixa de coisas comestíveis numa estação de investigação que contém cubos de comida compactos.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S4 E20 — Domesticação DigitalOs Lemmings andam à volta da cabana de troncos em busca de animais virtuais para capturar no seu jogo do tablet. Irritado com o seu comportamento, Grizzy atira-os lá para fora. Determinados a continuar a jogar, os Lemmings enganam o urso.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S4 E21 — Cenoura GlacialUma tempestade de neve arranca os painéis solares da cabana de troncos, e Grizzy deixa de poder ver televisão ou desfrutar do conforto de uma casa! Mas ele tem uma ideia brilhante. Ele produz eletricidade pondo uma rena a correr numa passadeira, usando a última cenoura da casa como isco.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S4 E22 — Espírito MaléficoGrizzy fica chocado ao descobrir que a televisão foi substituída por uma ilusão de ótica. Furioso, ele expulsa os Lemmings do seu esconderijo, onde esperavam ver o seu desenho animado preferido, e atira-os para o mais longe possível. Eles aterram numa gruta antiga, onde um espírito poderoso dorme.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S4 E23 — Sons e VisõesNão é fácil desfrutar de um DVD sobre salmão quando os Lemmings estão a fazer uma discoteca no mesmo lugar. Grizzy expulsa-os com tanta força que aterram na estação de investigação, onde descobrem uma cabine de raios UV com tecnologia de ponta.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S4 E24 — Grizzy GeladoOs Lemmings divertem-se a destruir torres de gelo. Quando Grizzy os vê, fica inspirado para esculpir estátuas de si próprio. Os Lemmings não resistem à tentação de destruir as estátuas de Grizzy, que faz tudo o que está ao seu alcance para as proteger.

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Loja de Doces Arco-ÍrisTom está a tirar selfies numa loja de doces. Jerry e Tuffy chegam e comem os morangos dele. Tom corre atrás deles.

Insatisfeitos, os lémingues decidem recuperar o saco de frutos secos e usam a tromba do elefante como um poderoso aspirador para roubar todo...

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues
programme.desc: S3 E45 — Ao Alcance do FocinhoGrizzy prepara-se para comer a última comida disponível na cabana, aperitivos, mas os lémingues chegam primeiro. A luta começa, mas é rapidamente interrompida por um javali. O javali devora as bolachas e, com o seu nariz, deteta uma velha embalagem de doces debaixo da cama, que também devora.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E15 — As Flores do BeanMr. Bean recebe um ramo de flores para a Sra. Wicket, mas atropela-as com o carro sem querer. Sem dinheiro para outro ramo, decide recriá-lo com flores que apanha onde pode, uma jarra de um café, um bouquet de casamento, até dos dentes de um dançarino de tango.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação

Depressa entra no carro do Sr. Paliwal e usa o drone para localizar o carro num armazém dos ladrões. Com a ajuda do drone, descobrem uma operação de roubo de peças de carro.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação

Mr. Bean vai para a fila, mas é demasiado longa, por isso convence Irma a visitar um estúdio de fotografias.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E18 — A História de Dois TeddiesQuando Scrapper abre um rasgão no Teddy, Mr. Bean leva-o ao hospital de Peluches. Enquanto está a ser reparado, Mr. Bean vê outro urso à venda. Decide levar o Big Ted para casa, assim que o Teddy é reparado. Mas em casa, parece que o Big Ted está a afastar o Teddy.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E19 — Bean, o EscaladorMr. Bean leva Billy a um centro de escalada, mas irrita-se quando um pai competitivo o acusa de ser um novato. Mr. Bean insiste que é especialista, mas é obrigado a prová-lo, quando competem por um troféu. O vencedor tem de ser o primeiro a escalar a "Gigante.

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação

Mr. Bean tenta mostrar como fazer o pedido, mas faz com o que anel de noivado saia disparado pelo ar. Aterra no cesto de uma bicicleta, voa até um carrinho de bebé.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação
programme.desc: S4 E21 — Uma Planta ValiosaMr. Bean foi instruído pelo senhor Paliwal para regar a sua preciosa planta uma vez por dia, enquanto está de férias. Tudo corre bem e Mr. Bean está a divertir-se com as engenhocas do vizinho. Contudo, um dia, esquece-se da sua tarefa e tem de entrar à noite em casa do vizinho.[AD].

programme.title: Batwheels

programme.title: Batwheels

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação

Mas depressa começa a irritar-se, quando o relógio toca a todas as horas durante a noite. Desesperado para dormir e quase ao amanhecer, ele tenta parar o relógio e as peças soltam-se.[AD].

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação

programme.title: Mr. Bean: A Série de Animação

Wicket sai-se tão bem que Bean decide dar-lhe uma lição a sério no seu estimado carro.[AD].

Mas os frutos secos especiais que comprou para atrair o pássaro, atraíram um casal de esquilos teimosos, que estão sempre a subir ao comedouro que instalou.[AD].

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues

Tentam tudo, incluindo tentação, para o afastar da consola, mas sem o menor efeito.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lémingues

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 32
programme.desc: Neste episódio, Tim e Rebecca decidem expandir o seu BAndB criando a primeira suíte familiar, mas não chegam a acordo sobre o design.

programme.title: Mudanças Na Casa De Família - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Sarah Keenleyside e Scott McGillivray trabalham com Cheryl para renovar a casa de uma família generosa e em crescimento que funciona como um refúgio seguro para crianças necessitadas.

programme.title: Remodelações No Jardim T2 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: O antigo jogador profissional de râguebi Phil, a mulher, os três filhos e os pais vivem numa casa sobrelotada.

programme.title: Renovation Resort T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Scott e Bryan agitam as águas na doca, com as equipas a criarem o seu melhor destaque, no desafio da sala principal e da entrada. Criar a melhor primeira impressão é crucial; irá uma sala lúdica agradar ao júri, ou apreciará um espaço mais virado para os livros?

programme.title: Kitchen Nightmares (USA) T10 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay tenta salvar um restaurante em dificuldades, mas a sua intervenção desencadeia acontecimentos dramáticos.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T2 - Ep. 26
programme.desc: A nossa viajante incansável Verónica Zumalacárregui volta ao Canal com novos episódios de “Comer Pelo Mundo”. Mais uma vez, pela sua mão, iremos conhecer a gastronomia autêntica de cada uma das cidades que visita.Neste episódio Verónica viaja até Bogotá.

programme.title: James Martin: Home Comforts T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Os longos e preguiçosos dias de inverno são ideais para saborear comida caseira reconfortante. James prepara uma tarte de frango e cogumelos em massa folhada e entrecosto cozinhado lentamente.

programme.title: Kitchen Nightmares (USA) T10 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Gordon enfrenta vários desafios ao ajudar um restaurante de brunch em Blue Island, enquanto as tensões aumentam.

programme.title: Remodelações No Jardim T2 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: O antigo jogador profissional de râguebi Phil, a mulher, os três filhos e os pais vivem numa casa sobrelotada.

programme.title: Remodelações No Jardim T2 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Prestes a casar, Reneé e Tasos trabalham no setor imobiliário, mas têm vergonha do quintal abandonado.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T4 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Bryan e Sarah têm dificuldade em comunicar quando se trata das obras e da sua nova casa de aluguer para férias. O segundo andar da casa, há muito esperado, começa a ganhar forma.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T4 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Uma viagem a Florida Keys inspira o projeto da casa dos Baeumler. Ambos arranjam uma nova solução para a vida durante as obras.

programme.title: Prova De Amizade T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: É numa caixa cheia de objetos de teatro e pistas com nomes de filmes, que os chefs descobrem que os seus convidados são José Raposo e um dos seus filhos, Ricardo.

programme.title: Kitchen Nightmares (USA) T10 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay tenta salvar um restaurante em dificuldades, mas a sua intervenção desencadeia acontecimentos dramáticos.

programme.title: Remodelações No Jardim T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Andrea e David adoram cozinhar para amigos e família, mas o quintal vazio não é ideal para receber.

programme.title: Remodelações No Jardim T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Nicole, Charles e os três filhos já não cabem na casa, e as festas do bairro são demasiado grandes para o alpendre.

programme.title: Fire Masters T1 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: A competição é ardente e feroz na Ronda Wildfire. Os chefs têm de repensar os alimentos básicos da despensa para terem a oportunidade de conseguir um lugar na ronda final. O Feast of Fire celebra os sabores de um Luau Havaiano.

programme.title: Fire Masters T1 - Ep. 19
programme.desc: Três chefs estão prontos para queimar a concorrência pela oportunidade de ganhar dez mil dólares. Na Ronda Crossfire, um dos chefs decide derreter um pouco de queijo e o júri delicia-se com pratos de inspiração marroquina na ronda final.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Mary usa cortes de carne mais económicos para fazer pratos cheios de sabor, como Costeletas de Porco au Poivre e o prato emblemático da mãe, a Fraldinha Grelhada.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T4 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Scott e a sua equipa alteram completamente o aspeto desta propriedade, para a tornar tão fresca e luminosa como a areia branca da praia onde está.

programme.title: Pastelaria Para Todos T1 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Em Pastelaria para Todos, aprenderá a realizar uma multiplicidade de sobremesas elaboradas por Carlos Fernandes. Desde os petiscos mais doces e tradicionais. O jovem pasteleiro ensina a dominar uma infinidade de técnicas para que todos possam desfrutar das iguarias de pastelaria em casa.

programme.title: Os Amigos Do Chef T1 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: António Machado desafiou o Chef Chakall a preparar 2 receitas com os seguintes ingredientes: castanhas, laranja e bacalhau. Chakall cozinhou Sopa de Castanhas e Bacalhau com Puré de Castanhas. Será que superou o desafio?

programme.title: Os Amigos Do Chef T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Vera Fernandes desafiou o Chef Chakall a preparar 2 receitas com os seguintes ingredientes: pesto, mozarela e mexilhões. Chakall cozinhou Capresse al Pesto e Spaghetti di Mare. Será que superou o desafio?

programme.title: Toma Lá, Dá Cá T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Luís Pinheiro, locutor de rádio, vai dar banho ao cão. Vai ser posto à prova, passando o dia a cuidar de cães incluindo a Japa, a cadela da sua amiga Catarina Palma. Fiquem para ver qual será a reação da Catarina, e como se irá o Luís desenvencilhar.

programme.title: Toma Lá, Dá Cá T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Querem festa? Então estão no sítio certo. A Benedita Pereira irá ter uma formação de DJ e irá apresentar-se como a nova revelação, a DJ Nita. Assistam à festa, é imperdível.

programme.title: Cozinhamos Contigo T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje, a chef Lúcia Ribeiro, irá preparar a receita de “Chocos guisados com batata doce” proposta pelo Mercado de Olhão e, depois, irá cozinhar “Sericaia”, uma receita que nos chega do Mercado do Livramento de Setúbal.

programme.title: Across The Strait
programme.desc: The Across the Strait traces the much-discussed issues across the Strait, reflects the will of the citizens on two sides of the Strait and details the Chinese Government’s policy of “one country, two systems” in a bid to enhance the Taiwan fellowmen’s understanding of the Mainland China.

programme.title: O Estrangeiro
programme.desc: Quando a sua filha adolescente é morta por uma bomba num atentado terrorista cometido pelo IRA, Quan, que fora treinado pelas forças especiais os EUA, não se vai deter perante nada para encontrar os culpados pelo atentado, por via de Liam Hennessy, atual deputado e antigo membro da organização.

programme.title: Fúria No Bairro Japonês
programme.desc: Chris Kenner é um polícia de Los Angeles educado no Japão e o seu novo parceiro, Johnny Murata, é um americano de ascendência japonesa, que vão ter de pôr de lado as suas diferenças e trabalharem juntos para enfrentar a Yakuza.

programme.title: Tempo De Sacrifício
programme.desc: Na Inglaterra do século XIV, um padre em fuga envolve-se com um grupo itinerante de atores, que descobre que ocorreu um homicídio e tenta resolvê-lo recriando o crime numa peça.

programme.title: Waxman O Atirador
programme.desc: Waxman é um ex-soldado das Forças Especiais que está agora a trabalhar como assassino para uma agência governamental ultrassecreta. Quando uma missão num arranha-céus em construção lhe corre terrivelmente mal, Waxman e o seu parceiro Clegg tornam-se os principais alvos a abater.

programme.title: The Boy - Segue As Regras
programme.desc: Uma babysitter fica chocada quando descobre que o menino da nova família para a qual vai trabalhar é na verdade um boneco em tamanho real. Depois de uma série de acontecimentos perturbadores, ela começa a acreditar que o boneco é mesmo um ser vivo.

programme.title: Um Mundo Maravilhoso
programme.desc: Num futuro demasiado próximo, onde os humanos dependem dos robôs, Max, uma ex-professora resistente à tecnologia, embarca numa perseguição frenética para encontrar a filha, recorrendo à ajuda de um robô qua a tira do sério.

programme.title: Snow - A Pedra Dos Desejos
programme.desc: O raro dom de estar constantemente a arranjar sarilhos é um traço que une estes nossos amigos! Que mais poderíamos esperar de gémeos criados entre trolls? Mas Kiara e Kai estão agora mais crescidos e o nível de confusão aumenta – desta vez, eles vão mesmo precisar da ajuda de todos.

programme.title: Cai Na Real, Corgi
programme.desc: Rex é um cão de raça Corgi, o mais amado pela rainha britânica. Um dia, perde-se da dona e mistura-se com um bando de cães de todo o género e sem um centésimo do seu pedigree… Só que nessa epopeia fora da proteção e luxo do palácio real, Rex vai apaixonar-se e encontrar a sua verdadeira natureza…

programme.title: O Homem Que Sabia Demais
programme.desc: Ben McKenna e Jo Conway são um casal americano de férias em Marrocos, que testemunham um crime e acabam por ser puxados para uma intriga internacional quando o seu o filho é raptado para os silenciar.

programme.title: Festa De Natal Da Empresa
programme.desc: Perante a ameaça do encerramento da filial da empresa e do corte dos prémios, dois colegas decidem salvar os empregos com uma cartada arriscada: uma festa de Natal épica e sem regras para impressionar um cliente decisivo. O que podia correr mal? Praticamente tudo.

programme.title: Agentes Duplos
programme.desc: Danny Gallagher é um ex-agente da brigada de narcóticos completamente desacreditado que ao sair da prisão se procura vingar de quem o denunciou e lhe matou o parceiro. Pelo caminho, vai cruzar-se com uma sedutora e implacável agente do governo e com o polícia reformado que fora o seu mentor.

programme.title: Mães À Solta 2
programme.desc: Amy, Kiki e Carla estão a entrar em desespero porque chegou a altura do ano em que estão mais sobrecarregadas de trabalho: o Natal. Mas há um último desafio que as espera: as próprias mães de cada uma delas vêm visitar a família, o que só vai aumentar o caos à sua volta.

programme.title: Big Game Instinto Caçador
programme.desc: Nas florestas da Finlândia, um jovem de 13 anos descobre uma cápsula de salvação do Air Force One. O homem ferido à sua frente é o Presidente dos EUA, e há um grupo de terroristas a caminho para tentar raptá-lo. Agora vão ter de agir em equipa para sobreviver à noite mais perigosa das suas vidas.

programme.title: A Grande Corrida À Volta Do Mundo
programme.desc: Início do século XX: o heroico Grande Leslie e o trapalhão Professor Fate lançam-se numa tresloucada corrida de automóveis de Nova Iorque a Paris, cheia de rivalidades, sabotagens e gargalhadas.

programme.title: Emboscada
programme.desc: Durante a guerra do Vietname, um grupo de comandos de elite americanos, liderados pelo Capitão Drummond, são encarregues de recolher informação altamente confidencial numa missão arriscada que poderá mudar por completo o rumo do conflito.

programme.title: Plano De Fuga 3
programme.desc: Quando a filha de um magnata da tecnologia de Hong Kong é atirada para uma prisão de segurança máxima na Letónia, o especialista em segurança Ray Breslin é contratado para resgatá-la. Só que a namorada dele também é raptada e a missão já de si difícil passa a ser de vida ou de morte.

programme.title: O Segredo Do Refúgio
programme.desc: Dois casais alugam um refúgio perfeito à beira-mar, mas em pouco tempo o que deveria ser um fim de semana de descanso assume contornos sinistros…

programme.title: O Homem Que Sabia Demais
programme.desc: Ben McKenna e Jo Conway são um casal americano de férias em Marrocos, que testemunham um crime e acabam por ser puxados para uma intriga internacional quando o seu o filho é raptado para os silenciar.

programme.title: Revolução (Sem) Sangue
programme.desc: Baseado em factos reais, eis a história de quatro jovens que seguem as suas rotinas diárias num regime ditatorial. Embora não se conhecessem, o dia 25 de Abril de 1974 trouxe-lhes um destino comum. O dia que mudou o rumo do país ditou também o fim das suas vidas.

programme.title: Blinded By The Light - O Poder Da Música
programme.desc: Em 1987, num subúrbio inglês marcado pelo desemprego e pelo racismo, um jovem de origem paquistanesa descobre a música de Bruce Springsteen e encontra nela a coragem para seguir os seus sonhos contra a vontade do pai conservador.

programme.title: Psico
programme.desc: Marion Crane é uma secretária que foge após roubar dinheiro ao patrão e vai parar a um motel isolado, gerido por Norman Bates, um jovem perturbado que vive sob a sombra dominante da mãe.

programme.title: Os Pássaros
programme.desc: Melanie Daniels é uma socialite que persegue Mitch Brenner até uma cidade costeira da Califórnia, onde, pouco depois, aves de toda a espécie começam a atacar os habitantes sem razão aparente, em vagas cada vez mais violentas e aterrorizantes.

programme.title: Os Três Mosqueteiros
programme.desc: Ao lado de um jovem recruta ansioso por proteger o Rei de França, três leais espadachins tentam derrotar o pérfido conselheiro real e a sedutora espia enviada para derrubar a coroa.

programme.title: Mascarade
programme.desc: Quando um jovem gigolo se apaixona por uma irresistível vigarista, um esquema desonesto é concebido à luz do sol escaldante da Côte d´Azur. Na busca de uma vida de luxo, irão os dois amantes tão longe a ponto de sacrificar o sustento de um agente imobiliário e de uma estrela de cinema reformada?

programme.title: A Filha Do Rei Do Pântano
programme.desc: Helena vive uma vida comum ao lado do seu marido e filha, porém, guarda um segredo sombrio: ela é filha de um “serial killer” conhecido como Rei do Pântano, que a manteve 12 anos em cativeiro e que agora acaba de fugir da prisão e vem em busca dela.

programme.title: Projeto 725
programme.desc: A filha do CEO de uma empresa de tecnologia é raptada por um grupo terrorista que pretende roubar o poderoso programa informático “Projeto 725” para causar estragos por todo o mundo. No meio do caos, só um destemido grupo de mercenários poderá evitar o pior…

programme.title: Le Chant Du Loup - Ameaça Em Alto Mar
programme.desc: Chanteraide tem o raro dom de conseguir identificar todos os sons que ouve. A bordo de um submarino nuclear francês, tudo depende dele, só que, reputado como infalível, ele acaba por cometer um erro que coloca toda a equipa em perigo de morte.

programme.title: Os Miseráveis
programme.desc: Stéphane é um polícia que se muda da província para os subúrbios de Paris, onde se junta à Brigada Anti-Crime e descobre rapidamente o clima de extrema tensão que existe entre os diferentes gangues locais e as forças da ordem.

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: No seu aniversário, Tyler e mais quatro amigos são levados pela namorada dele para um local desconhecido onde são trancados em quartos, dos quais só saem resolvendo vários quebra-cabeças. Só quando o jogo se torna perigoso é que todos eles percebem que algo está muito errado.

programme.title: The Row – Irmandade Fatal
programme.desc: Uma caloira de faculdade descobre um segredo obscuro sobre a sua fraternidade depois de uma série de homicídios aterrorizarem o campus.

programme.title: Psico
programme.desc: Marion Crane é uma secretária que foge após roubar dinheiro ao patrão e vai parar a um motel isolado, gerido por Norman Bates, um jovem perturbado que vive sob a sombra dominante da mãe.

programme.title: Os Pássaros
programme.desc: Melanie Daniels é uma socialite que persegue Mitch Brenner até uma cidade costeira da Califórnia, onde, pouco depois, aves de toda a espécie começam a atacar os habitantes sem razão aparente, em vagas cada vez mais violentas e aterrorizantes.

programme.title: Cinnamon
programme.desc: Após um assalto mal sucedido, dois jovens amantes são envolvidos numa série de eventos que ameaçam destruir os seus sonhos de uma vida melhor.

programme.title: Snow - Uma Viagem Heróica
programme.desc: Para chegar à malévola Rainha da Neve, Kiara, uma destemida órfã, terá que atravessar um deserto gelado e enfrentar os mais variados vilões na sua luta para encontrar Kai, o irmão que julgava perdido, com a ajuda da sua doninha de estimação, do troll Orm e de uma dupla de Pirata Mãe e Pirata Filha.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Trio élégiaque No. 1
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?
programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband.

programme.title: Verdi - La forza del destino
programme.desc: Renato Palumbo conducts the Orchestra and Choirs of the Opéra Royal de Wallonie-Liège in a performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s La forza del destino (The Force of Destiny). Verdi and his librettist Francesco Maria Piave based the work on a Spanish musical drama by Angel de Saavedra, ‘Don Álvaro o la fuerza del sino’. Composed for the imperial Russian opera in St. Petersburg, La forza premiered there in 1862.

programme.title: Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 1, Op. 11
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 1 in F-sharp minor, Op. 11. Schumann completed the work in 1835 and dedicated it to his beloved, Clara Wieck.

programme.title: Schubert - Winterreise
programme.desc: Baritone Samuel Hasselhorn and pianist Daniel Heide perform Franz Schubert’s song cycle Winterreise (‘Winter’s journey’). The 30-year-old Schubert wrote this masterpiece in 1827, just a year before his death. Like Schubert’s earlier song cycle Die schöne Müllerin (1823), Winterreise is a setting of the poetry of Wilhelm Müller (1794-1827).

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 12, Op. 127
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 8, also known as the 'Symphony of a Thousand,' is a monumental choral epic composed in 1906 that requires an enormous ensemble of soloists, choruses, and a massive orchestra to perform its vast musical tapestry. The work is a unique and grandiose tribute to love and the spiritual salvation of mankind, drawing from two distinct textual sources to create its sublime effect.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60. Count Franz von Oppersdorff adored Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 and offered the composer a large sum to write a similar work. Beethoven obliged and completed his Symphony No. 4 in the autumn of 1806.

programme.title: Schumann - Carnaval, Op. 9
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann wrote Carnaval, Op. 9 in 1834–1835. It consists of 21 short pieces representing masked revelers at Carnival, a festival before Lent.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Peter and the Wolf
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Sergei Prokofiev’s Peter and the Wolf, Op. 67. Written in 1936, Peter and the Wolf is a short, narrated orchestral suite, telling the story of a brave boy named Peter, who lives with his grandfather on the edge of a forest.

programme.title: Baroque choral music by Bach, Schütz et al.
programme.desc: Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig’s St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes sacred madrigals by Johann Hermann Schein, motets from Heinrich Schütz’s collection Geistliche Chor-Music, as well as two motets by the most famous Thomaskantor: Johann Sebastian Bach.

programme.title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek’s only symphony – was never performed during the composer’s lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 10
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer’s Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Derek Wang
programme.desc: Pianist Derek Wang (USA, 1998) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Allegro, of Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No 1. in G minor, Op. 25. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM).

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 7, Op. 70
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Antonín Dvorák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. The work was completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvorák’s broader oeuvre.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 38, K. 504
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek’s only symphony – was never performed during the composer’s lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Liszt’s Concerto No. 1 And Mahler’s Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: American ‘Conductor Laureate’ Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a program of romantic masterworks. The concert opens with Franz Liszt’s Piano Concerto No. 1, featuring the brilliant Czech pianist Lukáš Vondrácek as soloist. The evening concludes with the emotional journey of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 5. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on May 15, 2022.

programme.title: Divas and Diamonds
programme.desc: Musicians of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, the DR Big Band, and the Danish National Vocal Ensemble join forces under the baton of Klaus To¨nshoff in this dazzling concert featuring great songs from black and white cinema.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828.

programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. First on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 12
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 12. Written in 1837, the work is a set of eight piano pieces with contrasting moods.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bach - Goldberg Variations, BWV 988
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In the current recital, Bacchetti performs J. S.

programme.title: Sol Gabetta at the Lucerne Festival 2018
programme.desc: Argentinian cellist Sol Gabetta returned to the Lucerne Festival to perform Bohuslav Martinu’s Cello Concerto No. 1 (H. 196), followed by Manfred Grafe’s arrangement of ‘Lensky’s Aria from Tchaikovsky’s Eugene Onegin. She is accompanied by the Mahler Chamber Orchestra led by François-Xavier Roth.

programme.title: Sinding - Serenade in A major, Op. 92
programme.desc: Violinists Francesca Dego and Domenico Nordio and pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform Serenade in A major, Op. 92 by Norwegian composer Christian Sinding (1856-1941). Together with Edvard Grieg, Sinding was Norway’s best-known composer at the turn of the century. Composing in the late Romantic style, Sinding’s oeuvre includes a large number of piano pieces, chamber music, and songs.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Schubert - Rondo D. 951
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï perform Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Chopin - Introduction And Polonaise, Op. 3
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Frédéric Chopin’s Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Works by Gluck, Bach and Mozart
programme.desc: Venezuelan-born conductor Giovanni Guzzo leads the Camerata Fundación EDP of the Reina Sofía School of Music in a spirited concert. The program opens with the ethereal ‘Danza degli spiriti beati’ (Dance of the Blessed Spirits) from Christoph Willibald Gluck’s opera Orfeo ed Euridice, featuring flutist Matthew Raymond Origel. The concert continues with vocal masterworks, including J.S.

programme.title: Beethoven - Last Sonatas, Op. 109, 110 And 111
programme.desc: Beethoven’s last three sonatas – Opus 109, 110 and 111 – explore the intimate meanders of the human soul, from despair to transfiguration. At the time of their composition, Beethoven was already locked in himself by his deafness. This deeply affected his relationship to others and to the world.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven’s final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 7, nicknamed 'Song of the Night,' is a five-movement, entirely instrumental work composed during a more optimistic period, featuring unique orchestral colors from instruments like the mandolin, guitar, and euphonium. The work's unique sonic palette, including unusual instrumentation and contrasting timbres, along with its deeply expressive nature and sense of journey, are most valued by the public.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer’s only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically.

programme.title: Rachmaninov And Gershwin: Rhapsodies
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia is joined by acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin. Conductor Konstantin Khvatynets directs this concert, filmed at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow.

programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta.

programme.title: Verdi - Nabucco
programme.desc: Israeli-born conductor Daniel Oren leads the Orchestra of the Arena di Verona in a magnificent interpretation of Giuseppe Verdi's Nabucco.

programme.title: Martinu° - Concertino for Piano Trio and Strings
programme.desc: The Italian-Swiss ensemble Trio des Alpes, consisting of Hana Kotková (violin), Claude Hauri (cello), and Corrado Greco (piano), and the Orchestra da Camera di Mantova join forces in this performance of the Concertino for Piano Trio and String Orchestra, H. 232 by Czech composer Bohuslav Martin (1890-1959). Martin was a prolific composer, creating an oeuvre of almost 400 works.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Lensky’s aria from Eugene Onegin
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Puccini - La bohème
programme.desc: In 2012, Norwegian opera director Stefan Herheim brought Giacomo Puccini's opera La bohème to the stage of the Norwegian National Opera in Oslo. About his choice for this updated version, Herheim explained: “In bringing La bohème into a present-day setting with this new production we hope to revive the immediate power of suggestion and importance that this work at one time revelled in.

programme.title: Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries.

programme.title: Music in the air
programme.desc: Television plays a crucial role in popularizing classical music. Not only has it preserved precious moments of music making, but it also helps shape the future of music. The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. Completed in 1802, the work saw its first performance at the Theater an der Wien on April 5, 1803. That same concert also included the premieres of the composer’s Piano Concerto No.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 1. Op. 1
programme.desc: Piano soloist Boris Berezovsky is accompanied by the Moscow Philharmonic Orchestra under the baton of Alexander Sladkovsky in a performance of Sergei Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto no. 1, Op. 1. Rachmaninov composed his first concerto while studying at the Moscow Conservatory at the age of 18. The concert opens with 'Heavenly Movement', a composition by the young Russian composer Elmir Nizamov (*1986).

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, Op. 73
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. Popularly known as the Emperor Concerto and composed in Vienna between 1809 and 1811, Piano Concerto No. 5 is Beethoven’s last completed piano concerto and often performed by star pianists such as Daniel Barenboim.

programme.title: Britten - War Requiem
programme.desc: Paul McCreesh conducts the Orquesta Gulbenkian and Coro Infantil da Academia de Música de Sana Cecília in a performance of Benjamin Britten’s (1913-1976) War Requiem, Op. 66. Soloists are Tatiana Pavlovskaya (soprano), John Mark Ainsley (tenor) and Hanno Müller-Brachmann (bass). Recorded at the Grande Auditorio Gulbenkian in Lisbon in 2014 and directed by Yan Proefrock.

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 16, Op. 135

programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. programme.title: Franco Ambrosetti Quintet live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The composer, trumpeter and bugle player Franco Ambrosetti performs with his quintet in his native Lugano as part of the Estival.

programme.title: Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland.

programme.title: Karin Fernandes - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is pianist Karin Fernandes.

programme.title: Grégory Privat - SOLEY
programme.desc: Pianist Grégory Privat's 2020 work 'Soley' inhabits a hybrid universe in which voice, piano and synthesizer, Caribbean and electronic music, and the classical and jazz trio traditions coexist and mingle.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result?

programme.title: The Kenny Garrett Quintet
programme.desc: Appearing in the early 1980s at a time when some of jazz was refocusing on some of its historic values, Kenny Garrett was the first to show, through the dramatic intensity of his playing, that the alto could once again compete with the tenor saxophone, the instrument par excellence of the quest for jazz since John Coltrane, a musician whose influence he loudly and clearly claims.

programme.title: Brooks Bowman/Jazzmeia Horn, East Of The Sun
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Boogieball with Anthony Hamilton
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: La nuit des gitans
programme.desc: The Royal Conservatoire of Liège hosted a ‘Night of the Gypsies’ at the International Guitar Festival of Liège in 1995. At this occasion, the Raphaël Faÿs Trio and Quintet paid tribute to Romani-Belgian jazz guitarist Django Reinhardt.

programme.title: Recorda Me
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Gregory Porter and Metronomy - Paris
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: On Piano
programme.desc: Jazz first gained a foothold on Latvian soil in the 1920s. A century onward, this documentary traces the first two decades of jazz in Latvia in this portrait of Jack Michalicky, the first known Latvian jazz pianist. Michalicky was a musician from head to toe – a gifted violinist, he truly felt at home at the piano. Slender and lithe, the imaginative pianist’s fingers flew across the keys like a true miracle.

programme.title: Joe Turner - Jazz Marmalade
programme.desc: This vintage program, ‘Jazz Marmalade’, shows expatriate American musicians plying their trade in two Parisian jazz clubs in 1962. First, American stride pianist Joe Turner (often confused with blues shouter ‘Big’ Joe Turner) opens this atmospheric broadcast with a swinging piano-bass duet recorded at the Mars Club. Joe Turner (1907–1990) would remain in Paris for the rest of his life.

programme.title: Caetano Veloso, Aquele Frevo Axe
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: MPB Sessions - Pedro Viáfora And Celso Viáfora
programme.desc: Pedro Viáfora and Celso Viáfora are a father-and-son duo that brings together different generations of Brazilian music. Celso is a renowned composer with an extensive discography, while Pedro began his career with the group 5 a Seco before developing his solo work.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Ibrahim Maalouf
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: My favourite things
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: Charlie Haden And Orchestra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Bassekou Kouyaté
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Episode 6: Herbie Hancock - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American keyboard player and bandleader Herbie Hancock (1940) achieved success as an incisive, harmonically provocative jazz pianist in the 1960s, then went on to gain wide popularity as a leader of electric jazz-rock groups. One of these, Hancock’s band The Headhunters, ushered in a new era of jazz that appealed to a far wider audience, making jazz listeners out of rhythm and blues fans, and vice versa.

programme.title: Brubeck, Mingus, Smith - 7th Newport Jazz Festival
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Baptiste Trontignon

The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Woody Herman's Swinging Herd live in England 1964
programme.desc: Woody Herman: Live in '64 features a blistering one-hour concert from 1964 showcasing one of the very hottest line-ups of the 'Swinging Herd,' including trumpeter Bill Chase, trombonist Phil Wilson, and the amazing saxophonist Sal Nistico on the front line, as well as drummer Jake Hanna, bassist Chuck Andrus, and pianist-arranger Nat Pierce in the rhythm section.

programme.title: Mike Stern And Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat And Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis’ comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation.

programme.title: Hamilton e Laginha - Da Pá Virada Sessions

Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo’.

programme.title: Alfa Jazz Festival Lviv, Ukraine
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Gregory Porter - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble.

programme.title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer.

programme.title: Carrie Smith
programme.desc: Veteran American blues and jazz singer Carrie Smith (1925-2012) was often compared to the legendary Bessie Smith, an artist she greatly admired. She was best known in Europe for her powerful, resonant voice, impeccable timing, and the emotional depth she brought to her songs.

programme.desc: Decades after the 1930s swing era came to an end, one of its giants, pianist Teddy Wilson (1912–1986), kept the flame of this music alive during countless international concert tours. During a hectic spring tour of Europe, the acclaimed pianist appeared at Geneva’s Théâtre de l’Atelier on March 21, 1969.

programme.title: Give Me The Night
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Jazz in Comblain-la-Tour, 1963
programme.desc: In 1963, the small Belgian town of Comblain-la-Tour hosted an exciting line-up of both new and older jazz groups. Opening things up is the British trombonist Charlie Galbraith’s All Star Jazz Band, performing classic Dixieland jazz. Next up is German singer Knut Kiesewetter, who, with backing from the Prague Dixieland Band, sings the blues.

programme.title: Duets II: The Great Performances
programme.desc: Duets II: The Great Performances is a visually stunning video companion to Tony Bennett's history-making #1 album, Duets II. The concert features the full song performances from Tony and today's greatest artists as they were recorded live in the studio. The musical segments are enhanced by insights on the process from Tony and the duet partners, providing an inside look at this landmark album in an unprecedented career.

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin’ Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day’, as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice.

programme.title: O. Peterson Trio and S. Grappelli - Grand Gala
programme.desc: In the 1960s and 1970s, the annual Grand Gala du Disque was the awards ceremony during which the Edison Awards were presented to Dutch and international artists. These prestigious events were landmarks in the history of Dutch music broadcasting.

programme.title: H. Silver, M. Waters, D. Gillespie - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Alfa Jazz Festival Lviv, Oekraïne

On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen’s signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine.

programme.title: Trevor Richards
programme.desc: English drummer Trevor Richards (1945) is a passionate advocate for traditional jazz. After moving to New Orleans at 21 to master the city's unique drumming styles, he has consistently created opportunities to perform with the genre's elder statesmen.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton Big Band - Kurhaus Scheveningen
programme.desc: The Kurhaus in Scheveningen is a grand hotel in the Netherlands renowned for attracting both royal and musical nobility. Doubling as a concert hall, it has been host to several heavy hitters, such as the Rolling Stones and Ike and Tina Turner. On August 2, 1983, American vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Wayne Shorter
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Winter 1980: Maynard Ferguson Big Band in Brussels
programme.desc: The Brussels Jazz Club was filled to the brim with both musicians and audience members when the Maynard Ferguson Big Band performed there during their Winter Tour of 1980. From the first notes of the cover of Weather Report’s “Birdland” that opens the performance to the final notes of “Gonna Fly Now” that closes it, Ferguson gives his young sidemen ample time to shine.

programme.title: Song for my father
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Red Earth
programme.desc: American jazz singer and Grammy-winner Dee Dee Bridgewater embarks on a journey through Mali in search of her musical and spiritual roots. Assisted by producer Cheick Tidiane Seck, Dee Dee sets out to discover the ‘traditional’ music of the country, and to collaborate with singers, drummers, ngoni and kora players.

programme.title: Portrait of Roy Ayers

Between the late 1950s and now, these musicians radically changed music. Although sometimes hardly in the public eye, they have all been major sources of inspiration for today's major artists: Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks And Company - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: The New Conrad Miller Trio Live at Mocher's

programme.title: Rhoda Scott And La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues

There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

While traveling by boat, we visit the many palaces and temples on the shore. We also tour the majestic City Palace and the Garden of the Maids of Honor.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Great Caves Of Ajanta and ElloraCaves have held a special place in human development. The Hindu, Buddhist and Jain caves in these two UNESCO sites contain some of the most beautiful carvings and paintings found in Asia. This episode explores the history and relationship between these religions.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Mombasa: The Center Of It AllJoin us as we explore the Portuguese and Arab roles in these horrific trade schemes. We'll also investigate the pristine waters off the coast of the nearby National Park where our host dons a snorkel mask and comes face-to-face with the creatures of the coral reef.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: S2 E8 — Durban: City Of DiversityFew people know that Gandhi got his political activist start in South Africa. This is a city where Asia meets Africa and is one of the most diverse cities in the world. Here Journeys encounters people of European, Far Eastern and Indian descent as well as the local Zulus.

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: S1 E2 — 14-18On the 11th of November, 1918, the First World War drew to an end with a terrible toll... after a conflict unlike anything Humanity had ever seen before. For 4 years and 3 months, soldiers from at least 20 countries were plunged in the hell of trenches... caught under a deluge of bombs.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Five Paintings By Corot - FranceIt's the biggest museum in the world... the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies.

programme.title: Nomads

programme.desc: S1 E4 — The ClashParis and Berlin have developed and grown facing each other over four centuries of tumultuous historical relationships and mutual admiration. The architecture and urbanism bear witness of this complex and rich confrontation.

programme.title: Hidden Traces

programme.title: The Day When...
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Hitler Lost the WarHitler's downfall began before the official end of the war in 1945. Specifically, on June 22, 1941. Hitler launched the largest military offensive in history - against the USSR in Operation Barbarossa.

programme.title: Tout le Monde Ment
programme.desc: Claire Abel, une jeune infirmière, est retrouvée poignardée dans son appartement. La police conclut rapidement à un cambriolage qui aurait mal tourné et classe l'affaire. Cependant, un élément étrange fait ressortir le dossier : juste avant son meurtre, la victime avait porté plainte pour agression sexuelle à l'encontre de Mathieu Lecerf, un célèbre acteur d'une série policière et chouchou du public français.

programme.title: Au Bout de l'enquête, la Fin du Crime Parfait
programme.desc: C’est l’histoire d’un drame terrible au sein d'une famille. Une mère qui dissimule sa vraie personnalité et ment toute sa vie à son mari mais aussi à ses enfants. Jusqu’à commettre le pire. Cette enquête met en évidence les pulsions meurtrières d’une personne enfermée trop longtemps dans ses mensonges
