Seja uma doença, um problema na família, no casamento, na vida financeira ou espiritual.Por vezes, as forças desaparecem e não parece haver luz ao fundo do túnel. Mas, acredite que para qualquer tipo de problema existe uma solução.

programme.title: Saindo Da Depressão - Ep. 314
programme.desc: A depressão, para além de ser a doença do século, afeta milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Sintomas como tristeza constante, desânimo, falta de vontade para viver são sentimentos de quem sofre com depressão. Sendo este um problema sério com urgente resolução, o programa Saindo da Depressão tem sido a alavanca de mudança para inúmeras pessoas que superaram esta patologia, que infelizmente ainda mata.

programme.title: Nosso Tempo - Ep. 269
programme.desc: O programa mostra que não há limites para a fé. Todos os dias, casos verídicos de pessoas que superaram os seus problemas e hoje têm uma vida transformada.

programme.title: Milagres De Jesus - Ep. 224
programme.desc: Na Bíblia vêm descritos os mais extraordinários milagres. Situações que careciam de uma mudança e que são bastante comparáveis aos problemas de hoje em dia. Para todos os problemas, a fé tem um desfecho essencial, por isso veja neste programa, como os Milagres Acontecem. Os milagres existem e este programa é a prova disso mesmo.

programme.title: Reflexão Bispo Macedo - Ep. 224
programme.desc: Uma palavra de coragem, o conhecimento da fé inteligente, o reavivamento, a motivação para transformar um erro numa segunda oportunidade. Em Reflexões com Bispo Edir Macedo poderá reter uma mensagem única em cada episódio, que lhe irá deixar em reflexão e consequentemente mudança sobre as lacunas que enfrenta todos os dias.

programme.title: Oração Da Família Ao Pé Da Cruz - Ep. 313
programme.desc: A Cruz significa a vitória que o Senhor Jesus nos proporcionou contra todos os males na vida dos que creem. Por isso, de diariamente às 18 horas,junte-se a nós, para orarmos por toda a sua família. Neste momento, acompanhe também relatos de pessoas que foram transformadas de dentro para fora e que assim alcançaram a verdadeira felicidade, através das orações ao pé da Cruz.

programme.title: Heartland - Ep. 12
programme.desc: A série 'Heartland' acompanha a vida da família Fleming-Bartlett na gestão de um rancho de cavalos no Canadá, focando na jovem Amy, que, após a morte da mãe, assume o dom de curar e reabilitar cavalos. Ela lida com os desafios da adolescência, familiares e financeiros para salvar o rancho, enquanto a sua irmã Lou tenta ajudá-la com a sua visão de negócios.

programme.title: Nos Passos De Jesus - Ep. 224
programme.desc: Nos Passos de Jesus é um programa especial que vai auxiliar no entendimento da palavra de Deus, através de diversos textos bíblicos que revelam o conforto, o refrigério, a paz, a felicidade e tudo o que as sagradas escrituras contêm, para assim, se obter um sólido conhecimento espiritual. Neste programa, casos verídicos de transformação são também conhecidos e revelados como é ilimitado o poder de Deus.

programme.title: Em Busca Do Amor - Ep. 314
programme.desc: O programa Em Busca do Amor ensina-lhe os segredos para um amor pleno e duradouro. Entender como resolver as divergências e alcançar a plenitude na relação, são diretrizes essenciais para quem já tem um casamento. Já para os solteiros são transmitidos conselhos de como escolher e desenvolver um bom relacionamento e assim como dicas de como ser um/a excelentes companheiros/as.

programme.title: Quando Chama O Coração T6 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Quando Chama o Coração gira em torno da vida de Elizabeth Thatcher, uma bela e inteligente jovem, acostumada com o que há de melhor na vida luxuosa, mas que resolveu abrir mão de suas regalias para trabalhar como professora na cidade de Coal Valley, no Oeste do Canadá.

programme.title: Escrava Mãe - Ep. 62
programme.desc: Novela que conta a emocionante história dos pais da Escrava Isaura, que ultrapassa gerações.

programme.title: Palavra Amiga Bispo Macedo - Ep. 314
programme.desc: Diariamente o Bispo Edir Macedo traz uma mensagem de fé e fortalecimento espiritual para todas as pessoas que sofrem e enfrentam dificuldades na vida. O poder da fé é vasto e é necessário que seja dado a conhecer, por isso acompanhe este momento que poderá fazer toda a diferença, revelando a prova da existência dos milhares de casos de superação.

programme.title: Debate Publico - Ep. 45
programme.desc: A opinião do público é a voz ativa deste programa que todas as terças-feiras às 23h, lança para a mesa temas e assuntos da atualidade que merecem debate. Com especialistas e profissionais das mais diferentes áreas presentes em estúdio, este programa garante um debate aberto sobre tudo o que acontece.

programme.title: Fala Que Eu Te Escuto - Ep. 179
programme.desc: O programa Fala Que Eu Te Escuto é um espaço que aborda problemas pessoais e sociais da atualidade, onde são conhecidas histórias de superação. Com uma intensa interatividade, tal como o nome do programa descreve, este é um espaço amplo para a opinião de quem assiste. Em direto, durante toda a semana, poderá falar, que iremos escutar.

programme.title: Eu Sou O Milagre - Ep. 225
programme.desc: A afirmação é para muitos uma expressão que exige verdade e coragem, contudo no programa Eu sou o Milagre poderá conhecer depoimentos de pessoas que passaram a ser o verdadeiro milagre.Na primeira pessoa entenderá que todos temos uma história que merece ser conhecida, sobretudo quando se alcança a superação através do poder da Fé. Ganhe coragem e motivação neste programa que mostra que tudo é possível àquele que crê.

programme.title: Decisão - Ep. 224
programme.desc: Tomar uma decisão nem sempre é uma tarefa fácil, sobretudo para quem se encontra imbuído de problemas existe o medo de se avançar um passo e se recuar dois. Mas neste programa é transmitida a força e coragem para se tomar a decisão, a melhor e mais certa em prol de um rumo digno de conquistas, superações e acontecimentos positivos. Tome a decisão de assistir a este programa que será um acrescento diário.

programme.title: Casos Reais - Ep. 314
programme.desc: A história de vida, de cada pessoa, do início ao fim. Nos Casos Reais vai conhecer histórias sem filtros, a mais pura verdade de cada vida, contada na primeira pessoa.O fim de uma doença, a recuperação do casamento, o desfecho feliz de perda, aqui irá conhecer os testemunhos de pessoas que contam como alcançaram a superação, através da fé!

Temos todos os ingredientes necessários para começar bem o dia!

programme.title: 10 Animals That Will Kill You T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: From killer whales to moose, there are a lot of ways to die out there. The odds of being killed by an animal may be slim but just in case…here are ten ways you might die and perhaps how to avoid it. Yukon vet, Michelle Oakley and wildlife filmmaker, Filipe DeAndrade draw on their own knowledge and personal anecdotes to teach us a thing or two about critters that will kill you. But do those animals want to… really?.

programme.title: Africa's Big Five - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Africa's most iconic animals were coined THE BIG FIVE by trophy hunters. See these amazing creatures battle the elements and each other to survive.

programme.title: 20 Animals That Will Kill You - Ep. 1
programme.desc: 20 Animals That Will Kill You - Ep. 1

programme.title: Seen On Safari T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Buffaloes fiercely defend their own against lions. Elephants assert their power, as one bull boldly confronts a vehicle full of people. A cape ground squirrel stares death in the face, and male lions strike at hyenas. Around the next bend, baby animals bust a move, and a tenacious croc targets elephants with relentless 24/7 hunts. Intense, empowered and unfiltered, safari sights always surprise!.

programme.title: Africa's Big Five - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Africa's most iconic animals were coined THE BIG FIVE by trophy hunters. See these amazing creatures battle the elements and each other to survive.

programme.title: Africa's River Titans - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Africa is a land of giants. Its powerful rivers sculpt the earth and form impressive valleys and waterways home to many imposing and powerful inhabitants. These are the rivers where massive elephants and hippos live, feed and drink and where ancient crocodiles hunt and breed.

programme.title: Built To Survive T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin journeys down Australia’s rivers to find which riparian animal is most built to survive. His first encounter is with the duck-billed platypus, a peculiar and adorable monotreme, or egg-laying mammal. Phil then gets a grip on the ultra-slimy long-finned eel and learns of its extraordinary reproductive habits before finally catching a river-dwelling bull shark.

programme.title: Gredos - King Of The Mountains - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Through the cycle of the seasons, Spain’s Sierra de Gredos National Park, one of Europe’s most remarkable natural landscapes, is revealed. From ancient glacial cirques and deep mountain ravines to the summit of Almanzor, the highest peak in central Spain, discover a unique and fragile ecosystem. Here, the Spanish ibex, an iconic species that defines the spirit of these mountains, reigns.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: The Prairie Dogs of northern New Mexico deal with all kinds of threats, big and small. In the Flatlands, June faces an infestation of fleas.

programme.title: Built To Survive T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin wanders into Australia’s woodlands to find the species most adapted for survival. Phil first encounters the yellow-bellied glider, an intrepid marsupial with a built-in wingsuit. Next is one of Australia’s most abundant but deadly reptiles, the eastern brown snake. Last but certainly not least, Phil finds the iconic, cuddly and oh-so-sleepy koala.

programme.title: Dust - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In Botswana, where the Okavango Delta fades into the Kalahari, water and desert clash in a yearly cycle of abundance and loss. Along Africa’s longest zebra migration, herds, predators and desert survivors depend on the fleeting lifeline of the Boteti River.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: The quiet charm of Germany’s Central Uplands lies in ancient forests and wild beauty. Through the autumn forest, the booming call of a stag echoes through the mist. It’s rutting season! In Saxon Switzerland, peregrine falcons and black storks inhabit picturesque cliffs. The elusive lynx roams the forests, while in the Harz, a new, wilder forest is growing in the shifting climate.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In spring, the Carpathian Mountains’ rarest forms of life burst free from the harshness of winter, beginning with an extraordinary moment when a mother bear emerges from hibernation. Her three tiny, yet adorable, cubs experience the world for the first time, following her across sheer cliffs in search of food. Meanwhile, in Slovakia’s Tatra Mountains, a rare male capercaillie bird performs an elaborate mating ritual.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Life on the coast of Portugal is full of beauty and brutality for the unique animals that live there, from the smallest phytoplankton to the giant sperm whales. Fiddler crabs fight for breeding rights in the coastal lagoons. Cuttlefish, the ultimate masters of disguise, creep in on unsuspecting prey. Storks perch precariously on the Atlantic cliffs, protecting their chicks from predators.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Summer grants abundance, but in the race to make the most of a brief window of warmth, it also brings competition, aggression and danger. High up on the mountain meadows, Alpine marmots fight for the best hideouts in which to raise young, but can they escape hungry bears? The Carpathian bear cubs are growing fast but are at risk of being attacked by competitive adult males. Can their mothers’ clever strategies protect them?

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Autumn transforms the mountainsides of the Carpathians into sweeping carpets of bronze, amber and gold. The forests echo with the powerful roars of red deer stags, signaling the fight for the right to herd females. The battle is gladiatorial, and the weakened losers are picked off by wolf packs prowling for an easy meal across the forests. For bears, it’s time to gorge themselves on berries and nuts to put on weight before hibernation.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Winter favors animals with clever adaptations to survive. Even though the Carpathian Mountains are in the grip of snow and ice, they are still teeming with life. Chamois, a creature descended from the Ice Age, have special hooves to run across steep slopes without slipping, which are perfect for chasing females vertically downhill at the insanely high speeds of 50 kilometers per hour.

programme.desc: Vietnam was a land ravished by war but the nature here managed to rejuvenate and it has become one of the most bio-diverse places on the planet. This programme explores how this was possible and shows some of the most unique animals on earth that have made Vietnam their home..

Spearheaded by Dr. Pol and his son Charles, the Pol familys three generations are all joining forces to grow their animal loving empire and take on an ambitious new project: transforming 350-acres of undeveloped land into a fully functional family farm!.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Bullshark - Ep. 1
programme.desc: We know Bull Sharks swim upriver and we know they hunt in the sea. But we've never been able to see it all like this. We see them attack and consume other sharks. We watch their shady hunts in the deep. We follow them up freshwater rivers to pupping grounds. We see them hunt shoals of fish from drones above and we watch as they clash with hippos and crocs.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Property disputes are settled a little differently in Dogtown. In search of first burrows on their own, Pelt and Digit come up against some unexpected challenges from Badgers and Alpha dogs protecting their territory.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Super Reefs - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In 2009, National Geographic Pristine Seas explored the southern Line Islands and found pristine coral reefs, thriving ecosystems teeming with sharks and huge schools of fish. But in 2015-16, an unprecedented ocean warming event killed half of the corals. The Pristine Seas team returned in 2021, hoping to see some signs of recovery. What they found instead was the most spectacular recovery of coral reefs ever witnessed.

programme.desc: Octopuses break all the rules on animal intelligence. Born into the world as orphans, they are self-taught masterminds; capable of solving complex problems, strategizing, even planning for the future. Extraordinary superpowers that are the secret to their success.

programme.desc: Movie special-effect gurus are forever trying to invent more compelling creatures from other planets, hoping to terrorize our imaginations. programme.title: Wolves Up Close With Bertie Gregory - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Bertie is in Canada for his most remote and challenging mission yet; filming a wolf pack taking on their biggest and most dangerous prey, the moose. He knows these wolves, and this winter is critical for the survival of the pack.

programme.title: Built For The Kill T5 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: The big bad wolf is 100 pounds of muscle and teeth, but it's born blind, deaf and weighs just one pound. Built for the Kill: Wolf follows the transformation of a helpless pup into an accomplished killer, exposing real life-and-death struggles in dramatic second-by-second detail. The wolf hones its hunting skills over about two years of intensive training-and the lessons are hard.

programme.title: Day Of The Dragon - Ep. 1
programme.desc: The clock starts just before sunrise - when the temperature begins to rise. It’s hard work being the world’s biggest lizard on Rinca island. Competition is so fierce he can’t afford to slow down. For the biggest male on the island, an ever- warming environment and shrinking hunting grounds threaten his survival across every hour of the day.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Crows are as smart as dolphins and can talk like parrots. Wolves can hunt for three days straight in a territory the size of Delaware..

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: It’s summer in Michigan, which means time to bale some hay! It’s a grueling process, but Dr. Pol, Charles, and Ben manage to mow their hayfield, which is the first step in baling. But a surprise rainstorm could ruin this year’s hay haul. They hope for sun, so their crop doesn’t spoil before they can bale. Meanwhile, the Pol’s bring in their next animal to the farm – an emu!.

programme.title: Something Bit Me! T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: An expert river guide in Zimbabwe meets more than his match in treacherous waters. Despite repeated maulings that leave him with 38 major bite wounds, he survives to tell his tale. In the Pacific Northwest, a civil servant on a getaway weekend suffers a very uncivilized fate. Ambushed by a hungry animal, he goes toe to toe with his attacker to save himself and his dogs.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: It's the county fair season! The Pol’s plan to get at least two cows and six sheep at the auction, but they have a lot to do before that can happen. First up, they must install a new perimeter fence. Charles and Ben think they are off to a good start, but when Dr. Pol points out how sneaky sheep can be, their workload doubles. Meanwhile, Beth is hoping for a goat at the small animal auction.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest T7 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: The extraordinary oceans of Africa are home to some of the planet’s most diverse and vibrantly populated marine environments. From the rugged shorelines, to deep, beneath the dark blue depths, a mysterious and deadly world exists. Here, the hunter could very well become the hunted. This episode showcases how Africa’s marine life survive, with brute strength, cunning behaviour and killer instincts!.

programme.title: Something Bit Me! T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A hurricane sets two vastly different species on a collision course off the coast of North Carolina when a group of surfers paddle into waters patrolled by one of Earth’s most ancient and deadly marine animals. And in Fort Collins, Colorado, a trail runner’s training session devolves into hand-to-hand combat with a stealthy, heavily-armed mammal.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Africa's Deadliest Assassins is a tantalizing exhibition of the continents top ten deadliest killers, from the microscopic to the massive all forged in the most challenging of environments. Discover the terminators that have fought their way to the top of the food chain by evolving the meanest, biggest and most lethal of weaponry.
